issue: "estructura inconstante y rudimentaria" drops the source's "relatively" and its comparison ("as compared with that of vertebrates below the mammalia"); "mucha duda sobre su existencia en la clase" gives the pronoun referent ('its', 'It') and the class as if known, although R031 caveats say antecedents/species are not shown (class taken from the title only).
fix: ... en pocos ejemplares, una estructura muy inconstante y relativamente rudimentaria respecto de la de vertebrados inferiores (referentes de los pronombres no visibles; taxón tomado del título).

issue: "detectada desde al menos CS19 en el techo del DV": the quoted source says "Paraphysis was detected at least after CS19 at the roof of the DV" (after CS19), not 'from CS19'; the review rewrites the onset stage.
fix: ... detectada "at least after CS19" (formulacion literal del extracto, tras CS19) en el techo del DV, abreviatura tal como se imprime (Shiraishi 2013).

issue: "desde al menos CS19 segun un extracto [R501.1]": the extract reads "detected at least after CS19" (after CS19); 'from CS19' is a reinterpretation, and it is used here to compare onset stages across sources.
fix: ... y detectada "at least after CS19" (tras CS19, segun la formulacion literal) segun un extracto [@R501.1] ...

issue: "inmunorreactividad débil para Pax7 en estructuras membranosas que contienen la paráfisis, distinta del plexo coroideo": the source reads "weak immunoreactivity was observed in the membranous structures between the telencephalic hemispheres that contain the paraphysis, distinct from the choroid plexus"; the appositive "distinct from the choroid plexus" attaches ambiguously (to the immunoreactive membranous structures or to the paraphysis), and the review resolves it onto the paraphysis alone (the Table 1 row itself uses plural "distintas"). The authors elsewhere speak of "membranous formations of the choroid plexus and the adhered paraphysis", so their own wording does not state the paraphysis is a separate organ from the choroid plexus.
fix: ... inmunorreactividad débil para Pax7 en estructuras membranosas, distintas del plexo coroideo, que contienen la paráfisis.
